summary: 2d6 + ability + 1 per helpful item, meet or beat the DS. Dangerous actions deal the difference as damage, either way.

abilities.name: brute
abilities.label: Brute
abilities.help: Smacking things, feats of strength, hauling, enduring, resisting poison.

abilities.name: erudite
abilities.label: Erudite
abilities.help: Reading, perceiving, speaking, remembering. Magic is Erudite plus the right item.

inventory.note: Carry more items than your Inventory Score and every Brute and Skulker roll takes -1. Loot is heavy. That is the point.
